<RuleLanguageLinks current="javascript" languages={[{"id":"html","label":"HTML","href":"/assist/actions/use-sorted-attributes/html/"},{"id":"javascript","label":"JavaScript (and super languages)","href":"/assist/actions/use-sorted-attributes/javascript/"}]} />

## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.0.0`
- Diagnostic Category: [`assist/source/useSortedAttributes`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`react/jsx-sort-props`](https://github.com/jsx-eslint/eslint-plugin-react/blob/master/docs/rules/jsx-sort-props.md)

## How to enable in your editor
<EditorAction includeFixAll action="source.action.useSortedAttributes.biome" />
## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"assist": {
		"actions": {
			"source": {
				"useSortedAttributes": "on"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Sort JSX attributes by name.

By default, the action uses [natural order](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natural_sort_order),
which compares numbers by value so that `prop9` comes before `prop10`.

A spread attribute such as `{...properties}` can provide or replace any attribute. The
action therefore treats each spread as a boundary and sorts only the named attributes on
each side. It never moves an attribute across a spread.

## Examples

```jsx
<Hello lastName="Smith" firstName="John" />;
```

## Options

### `sortOrder`

Selects `natural` or `lexicographic` ordering. Natural ordering compares numbers by value
and is the default. Lexicographic ordering compares names character by character.

The following configuration uses natural order:

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"assist": {
		"actions": {
			"source": {
				"useSortedAttributes": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"sortOrder": "natural"
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```jsx
<Hello {...this.props} opt1="" opt2="" opt12="" opt11="" />;
```

The following configuration uses lexicographic order:

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"assist": {
		"actions": {
			"source": {
				"useSortedAttributes": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"sortOrder": "lexicographic"
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```
